sections.Profile:
Smart Set , produced by Williams Electronic Games Inc. in 1969, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Norm Clark with artwork by Christian Marche.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1969
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Boats, Travel, Rich People, Original Theme, Tropical, Recreation, Water, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Christian Marche
- Design: Norm Clark
sections.Editions: - Smart Set: 4,500 made, released 1969-06-01, model number 363
